owner_report: When I do legacy with Locked, the last thing that shows up on the screen is Native discovery complete - arming hook. It is the second boot screen under bootstrap 2.
title: Unconfirmed; Locked may be autocorrect for Lodoss, not a setting in this build.
previous_stage_binding: Only SCI-derived generated header; code callback targets reused for both independently linked low engines.

old_sci_hook_at_actual_legacy_target.effect: Targets the tail of the Legacy heap hook, skipping its prologue and original heap initializer, then popping an unprepared owner stack.

correction: Generate and validate both symbol tuples from actual low ELFs; select exact tuple for the chosen reader before arming, worker configuration, map binding and exit handling. No title list or reader-policy change.
proof_requirements: Actual compiled selector and consumers execute against both actual ELFs.
Arming slot and owner return frame use selected hook entries.
SD gateway and terminal/heap callback config fields use selected entries.
Map bind callback receives correct ABI and selected entry.
Mixed tuples and old SCI-only Legacy code targets are rejected.
Unsupported reader/transport directly stops without recursively asking the selector for a reporting control pointer.
